# MetKurd REST API V2

> Kurdish-focused AI APIs for speech, voice cloning, transcription, captions, OCR,
> diacritization, multi-speaker audio and audio separation.

Official website: https://metkurd.ai
API base: https://metkurd.ai/api/v2
An account and eligible active plan/API access are required. Use Bearer authentication
on all requests. Keep keys server-side. Generation is asynchronous: POST with an
Idempotency-Key, save the job ID, read status, then authenticate result downloads.

Repository documentation and sample code are licensed under Apache-2.0. This does
not cover the hosted MetKurd API service, models, customer data or generated outputs.
OpenAPI describes recommended functional fields; use string model values "1.5" and "2.0".
